module-checks.check-1: rtk npm test -- tests/snarc-sqlite-store.test.ts tests/snarc-memory.test.ts tests/mcp-unified-bridge.test.ts tests/dashboard-snarc-server.test.ts

scenarios.scenario-1: Observations, patterns, identity facts, sessions, and token stats persist in `.magra/snarc/memory.sqlite`.
scenarios.scenario-2: Legacy JSON memory imports without duplicate rows or silent data loss.
scenarios.scenario-3: Corrupt SQLite database returns bounded errors and does not overwrite existing bytes.

evidence-types.evidence-1: Deterministic assertions inspect SQLite tables, row counts, indexes, and transaction rollback behavior.
evidence-types.evidence-2: Trace assertions verify migration and import paths report bounded, redacted details.
evidence-types.evidence-3: Integration checks cover MCP, dashboard API, and SNARC memory API compatibility.

verification-levels.level-1: Run SQLite store and SNARC memory tests against temporary project roots.
verification-levels.level-2: Run MCP bridge and dashboard SNARC API tests against SQLite-backed data.
verification-levels.level-3: Run build, typecheck, MyGRACE lint, and full test suite before marking Phase-8 done.

telemetry-requirements.telemetry-1: Expose store path, schema version, migration status, and bounded error class without raw prompt content.
telemetry-requirements.telemetry-2: Report legacy JSON import counts and duplicate skips.
telemetry-requirements.telemetry-3: Keep query telemetry aggregate-only: result counts, provenance counts, and latency bucket.

autonomous-safety.safety-1: Autonomous execution may modify store code only with temporary-root tests and no live user memory migration.
autonomous-safety.safety-2: Any migration data loss, duplicate inflation, or corrupt DB overwrite blocks Phase-8 completion.
